about: Whole-library audit of Area's 58 approved families: consistency, visual quality, agreement with DESIGN_SYSTEM.md and owner decisions, interaction and accessibility. Eight read-only audits (A buttons, B fields, C choices and marks, D navigation, E overlays and feedback, F surfaces and colour, G conversation and code, H system). Evidence per finding is in reports/.

sessions.summary: Audit, emphasis roles (action and selection axes), section 1 fix-first defects
Eleven clear fixes, E-8 partly; default accent blue
Audit moved into the repo; owner picks recorded; S1 field focus, S2 weight rule, S3 concentric corners
S5 off-state greys, S6 soft plates and quiet ink, S7 standalone edges
S4 radius by tier, S8 joined seams, S9 close and dismiss recipe
S10 elevation roles, S11 list rows, S12 shortcuts and keycaps
S13 selected rows, S14 icon-to-label gap, S15 Segmented thumb and soft joins

S19 tone sets, S20 numeric marks, S21a/b density roles, token roles and hover gating (S21c dark pass awaits the owner's go-ahead)

decisions.title: Emphasis roles replace accent variants
decisions.decision: Two emphasis colours, action and selection, each neutral or accent, both neutral by default; accent variants removed from every component. Solid Buttons, Split button and Send follow action; checked, on, selected, current and filled marks follow selection. Row plates, the Segmented thumb and soft, outline and ghost Buttons stay neutral.

decisions.title: Fix everything in section 1
decisions.decision: The fix-first defects need no taste call: A-1, A-2, D-4, G-3, E-9, H-1, H-3, F-5, C-8, F-9, E-4, G-11 and H-15. The Card corner under Pill is capped; the Card corner rule itself stays S3.

decisions.title: Default accent is blue
decisions.decision: The default accent is blue (was indigo). Focus follows the accent, so rings are blue. Blue now equals info; accepted. Whether focus becomes its own role stays open (S1).

decisions.title: Audit workflow
decisions.decision: The audit lives in the repo (this file); the decisions page is generated from it with Area's stylesheet published as a separate file. One phase per session: owner picks, then about ten fixes or three rules, then docs, then a page update.

decisions.title: Audit picks
decisions.decision: The owner took the recommended option on every system rule (32 choices) and family call (59).

rules.title: Field focus is barely visible
rules.what: At standard contrast, a focused field's edge is the hover grey (#d4, about 1.5:1 on white) plus a 2px halo of 6% black. In dark mode the rest, hover and focus edges are all the same rung. Buttons, Checkboxes and InputAction in the same form use the 2px focus ring. Notion draws a 2px blue ring on fields, and ChatGPT a 1px blue edge. Verified live: the field focus colour mixes in the focus hue at 0%.
rules.why: Recommended B: both products colour the focus edge, the design system says focus is a system role rather than an accent choice, and it fixes dark mode. D is the minimum.

choices.title: Field focus visibility
opts: Keep the quiet edge + 6% halo (current, documented in CONTRAST.md)
1px focus-colour edge + focus-colour halo at low alpha (ChatGPT). Keeps 1px geometry and fixes dark
Make the increased-contrast 2px ring the default for fields (Notion)
Keep A for text fields; Select alone takes the ordinary control ring

rules.title: Where 500 applies: surface titles and labels
rules.what: DESIGN_SYSTEM.md says 400 for text and every title, and 500 only for labels on fills. In the approved code, 500 is used on the titles of Popover, Dialog, Toast, Alert, Card, Panel (bar and headings) and Calendar, and on Nav group titles; typography.md agrees with the code. Labels apply the rule four ways: solid Button only, every Badge (outline included), soft Count only, and every Segmented option on a transparent track.

choices.title: Surface title weight
opts: Keep 500 for surface titles set at body size (14/20, 16/24); rewrite DESIGN_SYSTEM and fix alert.md, panel.md, calendar.md
Return every surface title to 400; distinguish by ink or size (undoes the Popover pass-3 request)

choices.title: Which labels are 500
opts: Write the rule as the code does: labels on solid fills, tracks and static marks (Badge, Count soft, Segmented, Avatar) are 500; everything else 400
Strictly solid fills: outline Badge and Segmented move to 400

rules.title: Card's corner rule ignores the radius presets
rules.what: The owner's rule gives Card control-md + inset + step (22/24/28). It has no cap. Under Sharp the card stays rounded at 16, and under Pill the corner becomes 1015px, so the card turns into a stadium. Dialog uses the same idea with a cap, min(container × 2, …). The same leak affects Composer, Message and Toolbar under Sharp.
rules.why: Recommended C (the system audit) or A (the surfaces audit). They look identical. C also fixes Sharp for Composer, Message, Toolbar and Segmented, and gives DESIGN_SYSTEM a written rule to replace "Card is twice the container radius".

choices.title: Card corner under radius presets
opts: Keep the owner formula; add the Dialog-style cap min(container x 2, ...). Standard stays 22/24/28
Go back to container x 2 (drops concentricity with the header Button)
A, implemented as derived roles on the radius axis (radius-card, radius-shell) that Card, Dialog, Composer, Message and Toolbar all read

choices.title: Surface corner rule in DESIGN_SYSTEM
opts: Write it down: containers use the container role at any inset; a corner that holds a control (Card, Dialog, Composer) derives from that control plus its distance, capped
Harmonise the insets and corners first

rules.title: Control corners: stepped by tier, or one value
rules.what: Button, Button group, Toolbar and Split button use radius-control-sm/md/lg (6/8/10). Input, Select, Textarea, NumberField, InputGroup and the Segmented track stay 8 at every size. Calendar's 32px days use 6. In a small form row or toolbar, the corners disagree by 2px.

choices.title: Control radius by tier
opts: Every control reads the per-tier radius; Segmented items concentric inside; Calendar days take control-md (8)
Every control uses one radius-control (Button included)

rules.title: The "off" greys have split into four values
rules.what: After the Switch off track was lightened to #e2, the empty state of a choice control reads four ways: #d4 for the Checkbox and Radio edge, about #dd for the Slider and Progress rail, about #ce for the Slider thumb edge, and #e2 for the Switch and Chip. The Spinner track, at 25% ink (about #c9), is now darker than the rail, the reverse of what its spec says. Figma's rails are #e6 and #f5, and ChatGPT's off track is about #e6.

choices.title: Off-state greys
opts: One track grey #e2 (edge-control) for Switch, Slider and Progress; one glyph-edge grey #d4 for Checkbox, Radio and the Slider thumb
Lighten the rail to about #e6 (Figma, Untitled) and leave the rest

rules.title: Neutral soft plates and the second quiet ink
rules.what: Neutral soft marks are #f7 (Badge, Chip input), about #f0 (Count's 6% translucent plate) and #ee (Avatar, selected Chip). A #f7 Badge on a hovered #f3 row reads as a lighter hole. Count chose a translucent plate for exactly this reason. Separately, the owner lightened quiet Button ink to a 75% mix (#56), but Message actions override it back to #66, as do suggestion rows and Code block tabs.

choices.title: Neutral soft plates
opts: Badge soft (and Chip input) use the translucent 6% plate, as Count does

choices.title: Quiet ink for icon actions
opts: Message actions drop their override and use the Button ink; text-like rows (suggestions, code tabs) keep fg-muted

rules.title: Standalone surfaces have the faintest edges
rules.what: Composer and Code block sit directly on the page as white with a #f3 edge and no shadow. Card is #ee with a halo, the Table frame #e2, and Input #e2. DESIGN_SYSTEM says surfaces that stand alone take a firmer edge. It also says Card's edge is both "neutral 100" and "the divider role", which contradict each other.

choices.title: Composer and Code block edge
opts: Card edge (#ee) for Composer and Code block; Composer also gets the Input hover step

choices.title: Card edge vs Table frame
opts: Table frame takes Card lighter #ee (would sit lighter than its own #e2 row rules)
Card returns to the divider role
Keep both and document: Card lighter because its halo carries it; Table frame has no shadow

rules.title: Seams inside joined controls vs the "never darker than the container" rule
rules.what: The owner moved toolbar separators to border-decorative (#f3) under the 09-27 rule. Soft Button group and Split button seams stay #e2 on a #f7 fill that has no edge. The Button group spec found a #f3 seam "barely visible" on #f7. ColorPicker's inner #e2 rules are a clear violation and are listed as a fix.

choices.title: Joined-control seams
opts: Seams in joined controls count as control edges: keep #e2, write the exception into DESIGN_SYSTEM

rules.title: Close and dismiss are built five ways
rules.what: Popover and Toast use a ghost small Button (28, radius 6, Area glyph, #56 ink). Dialog uses a medium Button (32, radius 8). Alert builds its own button: full ink, a Fluent filled glyph, and a 12%-ink hover plate that is much darker on the neutral grey. Chip uses a muted circle with a Fluent glyph; Badge a 12–16px circle with an Area glyph. The rule says "28px, small-button radius". The API names are onDismiss, onRemove and onClose.

choices.title: Close and dismiss recipe
opts: Follow the written rule literally: every close is a 28px small Button

One recipe per shape: rectangular surfaces use the ghost small Button with the Area glyph (Alert adopts it); pills use a concentric circle with the Area glyph and a 12%-ink plate; Dialog 32 written as the exception; one onDismiss + dismissLabel API

rules.title: Elevation roles and the Surface axis
rules.what: The shared floating lift is written as a literal in nine places. Card's halo, Tooltip's lift and the Toolbar's four-layer shadow are literals too. So the Flat preset ("no elevation anywhere") still lifts every overlay, and Elevated erases the Table frame. shadow-3 and shadow-4 are unused.

choices.title: Elevation roles
opts: Add shadow-card and shadow-float roles on the Surface axis (none at Flat); document the Toolbar floating bar; Table keeps an edge under Elevated
Keep the literals; document Card and floating surfaces as exempt from Surface

rules.title: List rows: label column, keyboard focus and nested hover
rules.what: All list families read the same product evidence (labels at about 36 in ChatGPT and Notion). Menu, Palette and Combobox start icon-row labels at 36 (a literal 12 gap that ignores compact). Nav starts at 32 (8 gap), Tree at 52 (chevron, then a 6 gap), and Select options at 32. The offsets below are measured live.

choices.title: Label column for icon rows
opts: One label column of 36 for every icon row (Nav, Menu, Palette, Combobox, Select); Tree keeps its own grid; the gap becomes a density token
One 8 gap everywhere (labels at 32, follows density)
Keep; Menu is a surface, Nav a sidebar

choices.title: Row keyboard focus
opts: One treatment everywhere: inset 2px ring plus the hover plate
Menus keep plate-only (products, APG active descendant); Nav, Tree and Table move to an inset ring (offset -2, as Tabs); Breadcrumb ring follows its plate

choices.title: Nested controls on rows
opts: Nested row controls hover with the translucent bg-hover, which the rule reserves for unknown grounds
Nested controls hover with bg-component-active (still invisible on current rows)

rules.title: Shortcuts in lists, and keycaps inside Buttons
rules.what: You approved "plain menu shortcuts". A string shortcut renders in Geist 12/16 at 400. A Kbd shortcut renders in system-ui at 500, at 12px, or 11px when small (off the ramp). On a danger row the string turns red but the Kbd stays muted. The Escape glyph (⎋ vs "Esc") is still open. Separately, the keycap fill #ee equals a pressed or selected ghost Button, so the keycap disappears there.

choices.title: Menu shortcut style
opts: One quiet style in lists: a quiet Kbd renders like the string (UI font 12/16, 400, muted, text-slot inset); 500 and the keycap face only when filled
Keep the Kbd face (system-ui 500) but always 12px; no small Kbd in menus

choices.title: Keycap inside Buttons
opts: Inside any Button the keycap uses currentColor at 10-14% (the recipe solid Buttons already use), so it survives hover, press and selection

rules.title: How a selected row looks in menus and pickers
rules.what: There are five patterns. The Menu "Selected" tile and the Composer mode menu use a raw data-selected plate plus a Fluent check that screen readers don't announce. MenuItem checked shows an Area check and no plate. ModelPicker (radio) and Combobox show a check only, and Select a plate plus a check. The written rule says selected rows take the active plate.
rules.why: The navigation audit recommends check-only for menus, and the fields audit plate + check for Combobox. C reconciles both and makes Combobox match Select.

choices.title: Selected rows in lists
opts: Check only everywhere (Menu, Combobox, ModelPicker; Select too); add MenuItem selected / radio
Split by job: menus of commands and choices show a check only (the plate is the highlight); value pickers (Select, Combobox) show plate + check. Add MenuItem radio; retire raw data-selected

rules.title: Icon-to-label gap changes with the host
rules.what: Button measured 6 at md and lg (Notion), set as a literal. Inside a Button group or Toolbar the same Button is re-tiered to gap-md (8). Chip, Segmented, Input and Select use 8 (6 in compact), Tree 6, Menu 12, and a small Button still has 4.

choices.title: Icon-to-label gap
opts: 6 everywhere at md/lg: set gap-md and gap-lg to 6, Button sm to 6, hosts stop overriding

rules.title: Selection inside the Toolbar, and two "soft" joined buttons
rules.what: In one Toolbar, the selected tool is Button's #ee fill, while the Segmented beside it raises a white plate with an edge and shadow-1. In dark the Segmented plate (#1d) sits below its groove (#28), so it reads sunken. Separately, Button group soft and Split button soft paint "soft" differently: a different ink, edge and hover.

choices.title: Segmented thumb
opts: Keep the raised white thumb in light (ChatGPT, Figma); in dark paint it bg-component-active
One selection paint (#ee, no shadow) everywhere

choices.title: Soft joined buttons
opts: Split button soft adopts the Button group recipe (quiet ink, no hairline, row hover)
Button group children render as real soft Buttons

rules.title: One engine for everything that floats
rules.what: The overlay work gave Popover, Menu and Tooltip one JS engine with flip, shift, side and origin. Five surfaces still position themselves another way.

choices.title: One floating engine
opts: Everything anchored uses useAnchoredPosition; list overlays are Menus (Toolbar overflow becomes a ghost icon Button + Menu); Hover card at 8; InputAction hint becomes a Tooltip
Fix the defects in place and document each engine

rules.title: API vocabulary: normalise once while unpublished

choices.title: API vocabulary
opts: Normalise in one pass as proposed, keeping deprecated aliases for a release

rules.note: Owner took the recommendations on the open names (2026-09-30): options vs items, Input icon, Nav plate, Card list, Presence xs kept as a written exception

rules.title: Loading and busy are implemented as disabled
rules.what: A loading Button sets native disabled. Focus drops to the body, the button leaves the tab order and dims like a disabled one. A busy Composer disables its textarea, so nobody can type while an answer streams. ChatGPT keeps the field editable and turns Send into Stop.

choices.title: Loading and busy
opts: Loading keeps focus: aria-disabled + data-loading, clicks suppressed, full opacity; Composer busy keeps typing and turns Send into Stop
Keep native disabled but paint loading at full opacity

rules.title: Tone sets and defaults
rules.what: Accent is no longer a tone (your emphasis-roles decision), so the accent entries below are gone. The rest of the question is open: one feedback set for Alert and Toast, inverse vs inverted, and the Indicator default.

choices.title: Tone sets
opts: One feedback set for Alert and Toast in Badge order; neutral icon ink muted in both; inverse everywhere; Indicator keeps danger as a written exception

rules.note: Accent is gone from every tone list (D1); the rest of the rule is open.

rules.title: The 16px numeric marks disagree
rules.what: Three marks share a 16px height but not the type. The Indicator count is 10/14, below the 12px floor already enforced on Chip initials. Count sm and Badge sm are 12/16 with gutters of 4 and 6.

choices.title: Numeric marks
opts: Keep 10px and name it a ramp exception
Indicator count takes Count sm (12/16, 500); check two digits on a 32px avatar
B, and align the Badge sm and Count sm gutters

rules.note: 99+ kept on small avatars (owner: Claude's call)

rules.title: Compact density, dark mode and the token phase
rules.what: About 41% of dimension declarations (471 of 1,158) are fixed and won't compress in compact density. Mostly fixed: Badge, Nav, Tooltip, choice controls, Code block, Card, Calendar, Panel, Menu. Nearly all density-driven: Button, fields, Segmented, Chip. Dark rests on 26 literals that were never captured. The value clusters ready to become tokens with no visual change: the floating lift (×9), the scrim (×3), disabled opacity 0.5 (×16), the 16/20/24 mark ladder, and z-index (a token scale exists but isn't used). None of the 63 :hover rules sit inside @media (hover: hover).

choices.title: Compact density scope
opts: Add density-scaled mark-* and surface-inset roles (the handoff plan for dense products)

choices.title: Token phase, first step
opts: Now: opacity-disabled, shadow-float, scrim, mark-*, z-* roles (no visual change); prune or park unused tokens; hover rules move under hover: hover
Wait for the full token phase

choices.title: Dark mode
opts: Run a dark capture pass next, overlays and Card first
Stay light-only until the docs site

rules.note: Dark pass done (docs/research/dark-pass-2026-09-30.md, 19 captures); compact values for the new mark and inset roles are uncalibrated

calls.title: Selected Button paint: solid selected equals hover; soft selected's edge is lighter than its fill
calls.what: Solid selected is solid-hover, identical to hover and press, and that is the gallery's Selected tile. Neutral soft selected keeps a #f3 hairline over an #ee fill, and pressing it adds the wash again.
opts: Move the Selected tile to ghost (every real toggle is ghost); soft selected takes its fill as edge and resets the press wash
Give solid selected its own colour step

calls.title: Kbd API vocabulary
calls.what: Sizes are small/normal where everything else is sm/md; the treatment axis is appearance where Code calls it ground; on-emphasis has the same CSS as on-color; a deprecated quiet prop remains; Kbd adapts in Menu rows and solid Buttons but not in Tooltip.
opts: Merge on-emphasis into on-color, adapt automatically in Tooltip, remove quiet
A, plus rename sizes to sm / md

calls.title: Kbd's spoken chord joins the host's accessible name
calls.what: The hidden chord text makes a Button's name "Button Command plus Enter", and the spec also asks for aria-keyshortcuts, so the shortcut is announced twice.
opts: Hide the chord inside interactive hosts and rely on aria-keyshortcuts
Keep it in the name and drop the aria-keyshortcuts advice

calls.title: Open owner questions from earlier passes
calls.what: 1 Disabled seam in a group shows at ~75%. 2 Button lg 40 vs ChatGPT 36. 3 Toolbar "tools" size with 24px icons. 4 Button and Split button "re-review or accept as bug fixes".
opts: Seam drawn by the enabled neighbour; keep lg 40; route 24px tools to compact density; accept as bug fixes

calls.title: Select chevron and check are not Area glyphs
calls.what: Select draws a #888, 1.5-stroke data-URI chevron (stays #888 when disabled) and the browser's checkmark; Combobox beside it uses Area's 1.125 chevron and check in fg-muted.
opts: Under appearance: base-select, draw ::picker-icon and ::checkmark from Area glyphs; keep #888 only as the native fallback

calls.title: Select picker and Combobox list follow different placement rules
calls.what: Select never flips (pre-09-24 owner decision), is trigger-wide (a 96px mode Select opens a 96px list), max 288, ring + plate focus. Combobox flips, is at least 224 wide, max 324, plate-only focus.
opts: One rule set: flip, at least Menu's width, max 324, one focus paint (revisits the no-flip decision)

calls.title: Combobox selected option: check only, or plate + check like Select
calls.what: The row rule says selected rows take bg-component-active; Select does (plate + check), Combobox forces check only. Left open by the cohesion audit's fourth pass. Menu selection (S13) is the same question.
opts: Check only (ChatGPT's picker, Menu checkable rows)
Plate + check (the written rule, matches Select)

calls.title: Nested field actions and steppers are 24px at every size
calls.what: The action box is 2px from the edge at sm, 4 at md, 8 at lg, radius 6 (not concentric), and its #f3 hover on a #f7 soft field is ~1.03:1.
opts: Action = height − 8 (20/24/32) with corner = field radius − 4
Keep 24 but hover with translucent bg-hover on soft fields

calls.title: Read-only vs disabled paint
calls.what: Outline read-only and disabled draw the same #f7 fill and #e2 edge; soft read-only looks exactly like an editable soft field and still hovers; soft disabled gains an edge the enabled soft field doesn't have.
opts: Read-only keeps rest paint with no hover edge and a default cursor (as Switch read-only); disabled never adds an edge to soft

calls.title: Select placeholder state
calls.what: An empty-valued "Placeholder" option renders in default ink and reads as a chosen value.
opts: Leave it; consumers pick a real default

calls.title: Textarea lg differs from md only by 4px of inset
calls.what: Same 14/20 text and height behaviour; the owner already delegated this one.
opts: Give lg a real step (16/24 text)

calls.title: Range slider lives outside the manifest
calls.what: .area-slider-range ships as CSS with no manifest entry and no React component; its fill is fixed neutral and its size fixed at md.
opts: Document as a recipe and add to the manifest

calls.title: Checkbox/Radio lg only changes the glyph; Presence exposes xs
calls.what: lg keeps 14/20 text and an 8 gap, the same reasoning that removed sm. Presence exposes xs against the no-xs rule.
opts: Keep lg (a real glyph step) and drop Presence xs
One Checkbox/Radio size, as Notion and Figma
Keep lg with a real type step

calls.title: Choice card shares nothing with Card
calls.what: Choice card: 12 corner, 12 inset, #e2 edge. Card: 24 corner, 16 inset, #ee edge and halo.

calls.title: Avatar tone also switches treatment
calls.what: Neutral avatar is a soft plate; accent and inverse are solid. Badge accent is soft.
opts: Make accent soft, as in Badge

calls.title: ChipGroup semantics
calls.what: ChipGroup is a plain div with no role, label or roving focus; the manifest says it "selects one value" and the CSS promises a radio group.
opts: role=group with a required label; fix both descriptions
Add single/multiple modes with radiogroup semantics

calls.title: Indicator disabled means hide; labels are hard-coded English
calls.what: disabled returns null, and "N notifications" is a literal with no label prop (Count has one).

calls.title: Group spacing, legends and disabled groups
calls.what: ChipGroup gap 4/4 vs BadgeGroup 6/8; legend to options 12 vs Field label to control 6; a disabled fieldset dims options but not the legend.

calls.title: Chip assist, suggestion and filter look identical at rest
calls.what: kind is an interaction role, but the tiles present them as visual variants.
opts: Keep; regroup the tiles under Behavior
Give assist/suggestion a bare rest like ChatGPT's tool pill

calls.title: Open owner questions
calls.what: Count text 14 or 12; Badge md 0.7px hang; Slider thumb 16 vs 20, drag response, value tooltip, Shift+arrow; 12px glyphs in Badge and NumberField.
opts: Count 12; add Shift+arrow; keep thumb 16; keep 12px glyphs

calls.title: Submenu is tiled but not built
calls.what: The tile is two static menus with an arrow in the shortcut slot and a forced highlight; no aria-haspopup, no Right/Left keys, no RTL mirroring.
opts: Build MenuSub (haspopup, Right/Enter opens, Left/Escape closes, hover intent, mirrored chevron)
Remove the tile until it's built

calls.title: Collapsed breadcrumb marker isn't reachable
calls.what: The ellipsis is a static span: no keyboard stop, nothing opens.
opts: Make it a button that opens a Menu of the hidden ancestors

opts: Keep the three description placements; one empty-state row everywhere

calls.title: Tree view rests in muted ink; Nav moved to default
